verdict.rationale: Linear's integrations directory documents native GitHub integration (PR automation, issue sync, GitHub team review assignment) and native Slack integration (creating issues from messages, thread sync, notifications, and agent-posted updates). It also lists many other native integrations, such as Figma, Notion, Datadog, and Salesforce. Missing for 10: any evidence of a native Google Drive integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well these integrations work.
